correctness.rationale: Every one of 32767 nonzero ternary quartics lies in exactly one of 279 reconstructed PGL3(F2) orbits; 78 geometric-smoothness-verified orbits total 10920 forms. Two different conic-contact enumeration methods (quartic-local versus all-form conic-first) exactly agree on histogram 9849/840/210/21, with 28 smooth conics and 84 smooth-conic flags. Formal expansions mod t^8, exact Groebner chart tests, and Bezout justify multiplicity eight. One 21-element maximizing orbit and displayed witnesses, full certificates/programs attached.

value.rationale: Conic eight-contact is a natural extremal divisor event in the bicanonical linear system of a canonical genus-three curve. The complete equation-weighted distribution over F2 and the unique sharp-maximizing projective orbit quantify a mathematically specific small-characteristic arithmetic osculation invariant, not a routine restatement of an existing point/line or abstract-isomorphism census.
